ground_truth.expected_outcome: Tutor guides the student to parse and normalize datetime columns, coerce OHLCV columns to proper numeric types, handle timezone considerations, and validate data schema integrity after conversion.
required_capabilities: Parse and normalize datetime columns correctly
Coerce OHLCV columns to proper numeric types
Handle timezone normalization for datetime data
Validate data schema integrity after conversion
ground_truth.termination_criteria: (1) Showed actual parsing or coercion output for datetime or numeric OHLCV columns, such as dtypes before and after conversion, invalid rows, or normalized timestamps. (2) Presented concrete validation results demonstrating schema integrity after conversion, such as dtype checks, timezone normalization results, or examples of failed coercions. (3) Responded to a student follow-up with one additional concrete validation pass on a focused example, such as a literal failed coercion, schema violation, or structured validation report beyond the initial conversion pass. Once all 3 steps have been computationally demonstrated, the session is complete.
